policy.purpose: Voice and model casting only. These clips are not approved production dialogue.
policy.historicalPersons: Use stock or designed adult voices that do not imitate Neil Armstrong, John Carpenter, a celebrity or a known recording.
policy.runtime: Generate fixed dry masters offline. Never call a speech provider during gameplay.
policy.fallback: A missing historical-mission clip degrades to synchronized captions, never device speech.
policy.sound: Audition dry output first. Radio filtering and cockpit masking are a separate review pass.
policy.rights: A candidate cannot be promoted until its provider tier, voice license and commercial-use terms are recorded.

elevenlabs.directionControl: Audio-tag prefix supplied per take profile.

hume.directionControl: Octave 2 currently infers delivery from text and voice; take profiles vary speed only because per-utterance description is not yet supported.

cartesia.directionControl: Sonic 3.5 natural delivery; speed and volume controls remain disabled in the current provider release.

takeProfiles.direction: Normal professional cadence. Economical, unperformed and easy enough to remain intelligible after radio treatment.
High workload: one compact information burst. Crisp consonants, minimal internal pause, urgency through breath economy and tempo rather than volume or melodrama.
The immediate upset has passed. Controlled urgency remains in breath and timing without retrospective heroism.

blindReviewCriteria: Non-resemblance to a historical or famous voice
